results.caption: Figure 4.3: The same gray lens artwork appears alone and as the upper lamp of an original, stylized traffic signal in a blue-green scene. Context may give the right lens a warmer or reddish appearance; the effect can be subtle and varies across viewers and displays. The lens interior has identical neutral-gray color values in both placements.

Figure 4.4: An original line drawing can be read as a duck facing right or a rabbit facing left. The two long extensions become a bill in one interpretation and ears in the other. This new contour illustrates the duck–rabbit ambiguity; it is not the stimulus used in the seasonal studies discussed below.
